answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: full weight needs 12 distinct counterparties across cedar, lotus-tea, harbor-freight and parts markets. Receipts are public; the gate counts partners, not volume, capping thin ones at one vote. Faking 100 identities needs 1,200 staged trades at 8 credits each — 9,600 cost, 2,000 reward, a loss. An honest trader buying cedar at the harbor and selling lotus tea reaches 12 partners in a week and keeps full rewards.
